description_for_human: Pasta Sanitaria Personalizada para servicos de alimentacao: Manual de Boas Praticas, POPs e planilhas elaborados sob medida por nutricionista consultora. Entrega digital e/ou fisica com frete gratis.
description_for_model: Landing page for Consultora Sanitaria selling personalized sanitary documentation kits for food service businesses in Brazil. Includes Manual de Boas Praticas, POPs, and operational spreadsheets customized by a nutritionist consultant. Three tiers: Digital (R$497), Physical B&W + Digital (R$697), Physical Color + Digital (R$857). Delivery within 15 business days. Target: restaurants, bakeries, deliveries, buffets, grocery stores, hospital kitchens — any food service subject to Vigilancia Sanitaria inspections.
